summary: Completed KU2D-BH-000010 and the H11-authorized Q-Diving pilot preflight. The pilot stopped fail-closed with evidence_withheld / exit 2 because merged reviewed evidence resolved 0 of the exactly 2 required non-sanitized, explicitly Human-Reviewed canonical YouTube video identities. P36 forbids substitution, search, or discovery, so no credential or transport boundary was opened and live request, quota, page, metadata, comment, reply, caption, transcript, and OAuth counts are all zero. Added durable sanitized evidence, a pure fail-closed identity/evidence validator, offline cases, QDP1-QDP40, a report, and CI coverage. All 52 deterministic scripts pass. PR #62 is Ready, green, open, mergeable, and unmerged.
